howToUse: The durable goal state for long-horizon work. An agent picks up here after any context reset. Read this and progress.md, run `npm run verify`, then take the highest-priority item whose status is 'failing'. Only move a status to 'passing' when every line of its acceptance list is true AND `npm run verify` exits 0. Never weaken an acceptance criterion to make something pass: change it only if Jan says the goal itself changed.

statusValues.failing: not done, or done but unproven

invariants: Content lives in public/content and is git-versioned. User state lives in IndexedDB and is never committed.
Question ids are permanent. Changing one orphans that card's real scheduling history in Jan's account.
Never delete or weaken a check in scripts/verify.mjs to get a task past the gate.
Every module tier needs at least one question or it renders as a stage that can be entered but never cleared.
Deploy only when Jan asks. `npm run verify:full` must be green first.
